title: .to_string() on &str in production code (3 sites)
description: client.rs:490-494, client.rs:495-499, ws/mod.rs:189 call .to_string() on a &str value (clippy::str_to_string). All three should use .to_owned(). Two are in extract_response() (unwrap_or fallback literals); one is in connect_ws() error construction. cargo clippy -- -W clippy::str_to_string confirms all three.
